auto.name: Auto
auto.description: Follows the profile recommended for this computer: {{profile}}.

economy.name: Economy
economy.description: Raspberry Pi and small computers: at most 10 s per Explorer query, 20 s per report, little memory.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: Recent laptop (8 GB, 4 cores): three times more time, more rows and more memory.

powerful.name: Powerful
powerful.description: Desktop computer (16 GB, 8 cores): one-minute queries, two-minute reports, 50,000 rows.

piAdvice: A Raspberry Pi should stay on Economy: a heavy query would slow it down while rowers log their outings. A more powerful profile does not make queries faster: it gives them more time and memory.
aboveRecommended: This profile goes beyond the one recommended for this computer ({{profile}}). A heavy query could slow the app down: go back to Auto if it does.
aboveRecommendedPi: This profile is not meant for a Raspberry Pi: a heavy query could slow the outing log down. Go back to Economy or Auto.
memoryCapped: Memory stays limited to a quarter of the computer's: here this profile keeps the memory of the {{profile}} profile.
saved: The next queries, including those of your AI app (MCP), follow this profile.
advanced: Advanced: the limits of the {{profile}} profile
